root_cause: Jersey service discovery merged Kafka Connect parent service descriptors into the OCI plugin classloader
underlying_exception: java.lang.ClassCastException: org.glassfish.jersey.server.wadl.internal.WadlAutoDiscoverable from worker app loader cannot be cast to org.glassfish.jersey.internal.spi.AutoDiscoverable from PluginClassLoader
failure_stage: Jersey HTTP client initialization inside client.uploadLogEventsFile(request), before any HTTP response
standalone_success_explanation: The standalone JVM has no Kafka Connect server providers to mix with the SDK Jersey provider interfaces
fix: Scope SDK construction and upload to a context classloader that exposes only plugin service descriptors, including an empty descriptor to prevent Jersey fallback to worker services; restore the worker context after each operation
regression_test: PackagedPluginIT.packagedSdkUploadsWithoutLoadingWorkerJerseyProviders: previously failed with status=-1; now performs a signed loopback upload despite an incompatible parent forced provider
